home.h1: The right time, in your pocket.
home.lede: Your family's Vedic almanac: today's good hours, your kundli and dashas, every tithi that matters to your family, matching and muhurat. Computed on your device, explained in English, Hindi and Bhojpuri, with the reason behind every line.
home.fact1: No account, no server, no upload; your data stays in the app.
home.fact2: The rule, the inputs and the classical source behind each sentence.
home.fact3: No astrologers, no gemstones, no pujas; computation and explanation only.

home.cityPagesSoon: City pages are added in the next site build.
home.featuresIntro: Everything is computed on the phone, offline, without an account. Every interpretive line has a “Why?” that shows the rule and the inputs.
home.feature1P: One band for the day: good, neutral and avoid spans merged from Brahma muhurat, Abhijit, Rahu Kaal, Yamaganda, Gulika, choghadiya and Bhadra, with a marker for now and every segment behind “All 13 segments”.
home.feature2H: A daily note from your own chart
home.feature2P: Chandra bala, Tara bala, the day's tithi and nakshatra, Sade Sati state and your running dasha, in three to five sentences you can question.
home.feature3P: The janma tithi moves every year on the Gregorian calendar. The app computes it for each family member and reminds you the evening before.
home.feature4P: Ekadashi with its parana window, Karwa Chauth and Sankashti with moonrise at your location, Chhath with sunrise and sunset, Pradosh, Navratri.
home.feature5P: North, South and East Indian charts, planet table with dignities, fifteen divisional charts, Vimshottari dasha with “you are here”, yogas with the rule shown.
home.feature6P: Fourteen activities, ranked windows, and every rule that scored them: tithi, nakshatra, vara, Chandra bala, Tara bala, Rahu Kaal, Bhadra, Panchak.
home.feature7P: Ashtakoota 36 guna with plain explanations per koota, Mangal dosha with its cancellations, and a share-a-code so nobody types birth details.
home.feature8P: {lessons} five-minute lessons that use your chart as the worked example, a glossary of {glossary} terms, and a reflection journal marked “for reflection”.
home.festivalsIntro: Festival dates for {years}, with Purnimanta and Amanta variants, each checked against Drik Panchang before release.
home.festivalPagesSoon: Festival pages are added in the next site build.
home.appP: Free with ads; Pro removes every ad. Works offline, needs no account, stores your data only on your phone. English, Hindi and Bhojpuri.

home.appLi2: Reminders for tithi birthdays, shraddha and vrats, scheduled on the phone

faq.a1: No. The chart is computed in your browser by the same engine as the Shubhvela app. The shareable link encodes only the inputs you typed.

faq.a3: The birth time was marked approximate, or a position lies within one degree of a sign boundary, so the sign could differ. Unknown birth time switches to a Moon chart.

privacy.title: Privacy policy and grievance contact | Shubhvela
privacy.description: What Shubhvela stores (only on your phone), the one case data leaves it, ads in the free version, how to delete everything, and the grievance contact under India's DPDP Act 2023.
privacy.updated: Last updated {date}. Applies to the Shubhvela Android app and this website.
privacy.intro: Shubhvela works without an account and without a Shubhvela server. This page says exactly what is stored, where, what leaves your phone, and how to delete it. Processed under India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023 and its Rules.
privacy.stored: The birth details, names, relationships and family dates you enter; ancestor records for shraddha; reminder choices; saved muhurats; journal notes; and settings. Everything is stored only on your phone, in the app's own database. There is no account, no sign-in and no Shubhvela server; nothing is uploaded.
privacy.leavesH: The one time data leaves the phone
privacy.leaves: When you tap “Search online” while entering a place, the typed place name is sent to OpenStreetMap's Nominatim service (identified as Shubhvela) to find its coordinates and time zone. Only the town you then choose is kept. Nothing else is ever sent by the app.
privacy.ads: The free version shows ads through Google AdMob. The AdMob SDK collects device and advertising identifiers under Google's own policy and asks for its own consent where the law requires it (EEA and UK). Pro removes every ad and never starts the ads SDK.
privacy.billing: Pro subscriptions and one-time reports are sold through Google Play Billing. Google processes the payment under its own terms; Shubhvela stores only the purchase state on your phone to unlock what you bought.
privacy.website: The site is static pages hosted on GitHub Pages; GitHub may keep standard server logs under its own privacy statement. The site sets no cookies and runs no analytics. The kundli generator computes in your browser; the only thing it remembers is your theme choice, kept in your browser's local storage. A shared kundli link carries the birth details you typed in the link itself, so share it as you would share those details.
privacy.delete: In the app: Settings → Privacy → Delete everything removes all data at once. Uninstalling the app does the same. There is nothing to delete on a server, because nothing was uploaded.
privacy.grievance: Grievance officer: {email} ({note}). Complaints are answered within the period set by the DPDP Rules.
privacy.incident: Shubhvela has no server, so a data incident can only concern a phone or the optional online place search. Any incident is handled within 72 hours following the process published in the project repository.
privacy.source: The app and this site are open source (MIT). You can read what the code does at {url}.
terms.title: Terms of use | Shubhvela
terms.description: Terms for the Shubhvela app and website: what the service is, what it is not, free and Pro, and the disclaimers.
terms.service: Shubhvela is a computation-first Vedic almanac: panchang, kundli, dashas, family tithis, muhurat windows and matching, computed on your device from classical rules and astronomical positions. It has no astrologers, no consultations and sells no remedies.
terms.reflection: Everything Shubhvela shows is guidance for reflection, computed from classical rules and today's sky. It does not predict events. Nothing here is medical, legal or financial advice; for such matters consult a qualified professional. No outcome is promised or guaranteed, and nothing is sold or recommended to change one.
terms.freePro: The app is free with ads. Pro removes ads and unlocks the features listed on the Pro screen; it is billed by Google Play as a monthly, yearly or lifetime purchase and can be cancelled in Play → Subscriptions. One-time reports are sold the same way. Prices are shown in Play before you buy.
terms.accuracy: Positions come from the astronomy-engine ephemeris with the Lahiri ayanamsa by default; time zones follow the IANA database with historical rules. The engine is checked against published reference calculators and the measured deviations are recorded in the open-source repository. Conventions differ between traditions; where Shubhvela follows one, it says so.
terms.use: You may use the app and the site for personal, non-commercial purposes. The code is open source under the MIT licence; fonts, place data and the vendored libraries carry their own licences, listed in the app under About → Licences and in the repository's third-party notices.
terms.liability: The software is provided as is, without warranty of any kind. To the extent the law allows, Shubhvela is not liable for decisions taken on the basis of what it shows.
terms.law: These terms are governed by the laws of India.
deletion.title: Delete your data | Shubhvela
deletion.description: How to delete every Shubhvela record: the app stores data only on your phone, so Settings → Privacy → Delete everything or uninstalling removes it all.
deletion.intro: Shubhvela keeps your data only on your phone. There is no account and no server copy, so deletion is immediate and complete.
deletion.step1: Open Settings (the gear at the top right of any tab).
deletion.step3: Confirm. Every profile, ancestor record, family date, reminder, saved muhurat, journal entry and setting is removed at once.
deletion.uninstall: Uninstalling the app deletes its database. If you made an encrypted backup file, delete that file too; it is the only other copy, and it exists only where you saved it.
deletion.purchases: Purchase records belong to your Google account and Google Play; deleting the app's data does not cancel a subscription. Cancel in Play → Subscriptions.
deletion.website: The site stores only your theme choice in your browser's local storage; clear site data in the browser to remove it. A shared kundli link contains the birth details in the link itself; delete the message that carried it.

panchang.segmentsNote: One rule colours both the band and this list: Avoid = Rahu Kaal, Yamaganda, Gulika, Kaal/Rog/Udveg choghadiya; Good = Abhijit, Brahma muhurat, Shubh/Labh/Amrit choghadiya minus Avoid; Neutral = Chal and the rest. Bhadra and Panchak are flags, not colours. The app adds a “Why?” to every row.
